`Clinic::Configuration::UcumDimensions` is an application-owned bounded linear-dimension evaluator. It consumes these definitions; it does not modify them, seed a clinic/test catalog, calculate result conversions or claim UCUM full conformance. It rejects special/non-ratio or arbitrary units rather than treating their definition placeholders as dimensionless. Definitions updates require an explicit new engine version and verification; they are never fetched at runtime.
